articles.summary: Dallas, Texas, Feb. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — CompX International Inc. (NYSE American: CIX) announced today that, subject to the completion of year-end closing procedures, it expects to report fourth quarter 2025 earnings in a press release after market close on Wednesday, March 4, 2026. ...
articles.title: COMPX ANNOUNCES EXPECTED FOURTH QUARTER 2025 EARNINGS RELEASE DATE
